subject: Pilot pricing: soft-cap safeguard vs volume-threshold discount (NovusAI)
messages:
From: Ellis Chen <ellis@novusai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwo od.ai
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@novusai.com>, procurement@novusai.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:04:12 -0700
Subject: Pilot pricing: seeking runway soft-cap and graduated discount path

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We think Redwood's inference latency profile looks promising for our annotation pipeline. Before we move engineering time to integration, procurement is asking for two things so we can decide on a short extension:

1) A short 'soft-cap' option for a 3-week pilot extension where NovusAI won't be billed beyond a defined token cap but Redwood guarantees continued access for the extension window.
2) A clear graduated discount ladder if we convert to a 3-month paid pilot or commit to a minimum throughput after the trial (we're sensitive to early price cliffs).

Attached is a small sample of the pilot dataset (novusai-pilot-data-sample.csv) so you can confirm our volume projections. Can you put together two simple paths (soft-cap addendum + conversion discount ladder) that procurement and legal can review quickly? We prefer a single one-page addendum + quote if possible.

Leah (cc) will coordinate procurement. We're hoping for a one-business-day turnaround on the quote if doable.

Appreciate it —
Ellis Chen
Head of ML Ops, NovusAI
ellis@novusai.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Chen <ellis@novusai.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:27:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing: seeking runway soft-cap and graduated discount path

Ellis — thanks for the clear ask and for the sample. Quick response with two clean options below; I attached a short quote and a one-page addendum draft (redwood-softcap-quote-20270609.pdf, redwood-pilot-addendum-draft.docx).

Option A — Soft-cap safeguard (recommended when you need predictable trial runway)
- 3-week extension
- Token soft-cap: 1,000,000 tokens included; if the cap is reached we will pause ingestion and notify NovusAI rather than auto-bill overage.
- Fixed extension fee: $6,000 flat for the 3-week window (covers reserved concurrency and priority routing).
- SLA: continuity guarantee during the extension window; standard error budget applies.
- Conversion: if you convert to a paid pilot within 14 days, we will credit 50% of the extension fee toward the first invoice.

Option B — Volume-threshold discount ladder (recommended when you expect to burst and want unit-cost visibility)
- No hard cap; usage billed per-token at published rate, with pre-agreed volume discount tiers:
  * 0–5M tokens: baseline rate (no discount)
  * 5M–15M tokens: 8% discount on token unit price
  * >15M tokens: 14% discount on token unit price
- Commitment window: tiered discounts applied retroactively to the month if thresholds are met.
- If you convert to a 3-month paid pilot and hit threshold X (we'll map to your sample), we can apply an additional 5% onboarding credit.

Next steps (suggested):
- Naomi: confirm the technical SLOs we should include in the addendum (latency percentiles, allowed error budget).
- Legal: Dev, if you could scan the addendum for any sticky clauses and propose a single sentence to handle the pause/overage behavior.
- Ellis/Leah: pick Option A or B (or a hybrid) and we'll produce a signed addendum + DocuSign link.

I can turn the formal quote + DocuSign package around today if you confirm which path you prefer.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 14:05:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing: seeking runway soft-cap and graduated discount path

Ellis / Rishi — quick technical note on what we'd propose including in the addendum so success criteria are unambiguous: 

- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 220ms wall-clock on your representative 512-token requests during the pilot window, measured at the per-route level.
- Throughput safeguard: reserved burst of 50 concurrent inference streams for the 3-week extension under Option A.
- Data handling: we will disable telemetry sampling of PII and follow your retention spec (14 days by default for pilot logs).
- Monitoring: we will provide a read-only dashboard link for token usage and per-route latency, updated every 5 minutes.

If these match your expectations I'll embed them in the one-page addendum so procurement sees the acceptance criteria alongside pricing.

— Naomi
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@novusai.com>, Ellis Chen <ellis@novusai.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing: seeking runway soft-cap and graduated discount path

Leah / Ellis — from a legal ops perspective a concise amendment will speed procurement review. Two suggested small edits to the redwood-pilot-addendum-draft.docx: 

1) Pause behavior: change the line that reads 'we will pause ingestion' to 'we will pause ingestion and block additional tokens until the parties mutually agree to a cap increase or sign a conversion agreement; no automatic overage billing will occur during the extension.'
2) Liability carveout: add a single sentence limiting credits to the extension fee for any downtime during the soft-cap window (keeps the ask simple for procurement).

If you approve these two points we can circulate a DocuSign package today.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Senior Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot pricing: seeking runway soft-cap and graduated discount path

Rishi / Team — thanks, this is exactly what procurement wanted to see. NovusAI will proceed with Option A (Soft-cap safeguard) for a 3-week extension with the proposed 1,000,000 token soft-cap and the $6,000 extension fee. We also accept the conversion credit language (50% credit toward first invoice if converted within 14 days).

Please send the DocuSign link for the one-page addendum and the quote. Leah will countersign on our side. Naomi — the latency SLOs you listed look good; we'll test against the supplied sample.

Ellis Chen
Head of ML Ops, NovusAI
ellis@novusai.com
